observedIndicators: Failure occurred during deterministic cache replay inside .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js
Cached selector targeted '[data-testid=\'input-lastname\']' and 'Last Name *', but the failure screenshot shows 'Your Name *' and 'Contact Email *'
The overall objective is semantically flexible ('Fill out all of the survey questions with fake data...') and intended to handle layout shifts
No application console errors or network 5xx failures detected in browser logs

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry autonomously
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache file tests/.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js and re-run the test autonomously so the AI agent inspects and interacts with the current form fields.

remediationSteps.summary: Review instruction flexibility if autonomous runs fail
remediationSteps.details: If the survey form contains high variability between runs, ensure the Page.AI instruction remains broad and flexible to handle random permutations.

plan.notes: The survey form shifts layout and field names across sessions. The cached replay attempted to fill 'Last Name', but the active DOM displays 'Your Name' and 'Contact Email'. Clearing the cache will allow autonomous Page.AI to fill the current form fields.
